title: Bugfix/issue 13425 shopify wrong curr amount refund
summary: Fixed Shopify refund sales line creation to use the correct amount when shop and presentment currencies differ.
key_points: Corrects currency amount used in sales line generation from refund shipping lines
Addresses issue where wrong amount was applied with different shop and presentment currencies
Updates Shopify order refund processing logic
Includes test coverage for the refund shipping line scenario
quote: Wrong amount is used to create sales line from refund shipping line when shop currency and presentment currency is not the same.
